# Minimal phevaluator build for poker-engine (5/6/7-card Hold'em only)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)

add_library(pheval STATIC
  src/dptables.c
  src/tables_bitwise.c
  src/evaluator5.c
  src/evaluator5.cc
  src/evaluator6.c
  src/evaluator6.cc
  src/evaluator7.c
  src/evaluator7.cc
  src/hashtable5.c
  src/hashtable6.c
  src/hashtable7.c
  src/hashtable.c
  src/hash.c
  src/rank.c
  src/7462.c
)

target_include_directories(pheval PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

target_compile_options(pheval PRIVATE -O3 -w)
